name: @admin-kit-yu/react
description: Frontend UI engine for AdminKit providing dynamic data tables, forms, and diagnostic studio

scripts.build: vite build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); const src=path.resolve('../../examples/react-demo/dist'); const dst=path.resolve('dist'); if(fs.existsSync(src)) fs.cpSync(src, dst, { recursive: true, force: true });"
scripts.postbuild: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); const src=path.resolve('../../examples/react-demo/dist'); const dst=path.resolve('dist'); if(fs.existsSync(src)) fs.cpSync(src, dst, { recursive: true, force: true });"
